description: SPL.ts native cookbook — 61 pure-TypeScript recipes, no Python tools. All pass echo adapter.

recipes.name: Hello World
recipes.description: Simplest possible workflow — one GENERATE, one output variable

recipes.name: Chain of Thought
recipes.description: Sequential GENERATE INTO — break a problem into steps before answering
args: question=If a train leaves Chicago at 9am travelling at 60mph towards New York 790 miles away, and another train leaves New York at 10am at 80mph, when do they meet?

recipes.name: Self-Refine
recipes.description: WHILE + EVALUATE + COMMIT — iterative quality improvement loop
args: topic=the importance of sleep for cognitive performance

recipes.name: Nested Procedures
recipes.description: PROCEDURE + CALL chain — modular sub-task decomposition

recipes.name: Parallel Perspectives
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL ... END — three viewpoints generated simultaneously, then synthesized

recipes.name: Sentiment Router
recipes.description: Multi-branch EVALUATE — classify input then route to positive/negative/neutral handler
args: text=This product exceeded all my expectations. The build quality is outstanding!

recipes.name: Batch Processing
recipes.description: WHILE + list_get (1-based) + list_length — process a comma-separated list item by item

recipes.name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
recipes.description: PROCEDURE delegation + LOGGING — specialist agents hand off work via CALL chain

recipes.name: Code Gen + Tests
recipes.description: Sequential generation pipeline: spec → code → tests → review
args: spec=Write a Python function that validates email addresses using regex

recipes.name: Data Pipeline
recipes.description: json_get + iif with comparison args — extract, validate, and transform structured data

recipes.name: Debate Arena
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL opening statements + WHILE rebuttals — structured adversarial discourse
args: topic=Artificial intelligence will eliminate more jobs than it creates

recipes.name: Reflection Agent
recipes.description: WHILE + EVALUATE > 0.85 — attempt → critique → refine until quality threshold met
args: task=Write a concise executive summary of the challenges in AI safety alignment

recipes.name: Ensemble Voting
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL 5-way candidate generation + score/consensus/select winner
args: question=What is the best strategy for learning a new programming language quickly?

recipes.name: Parallel News
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL sub-WORKFLOWs + fan-out merge — three articles summarized simultaneously

recipes.name: Progressive Summary
recipes.description: 3-layer compression: sentence → paragraph → page; EVALUATE >= 3 routing
args: topic=the history and impact of the internet

recipes.name: Hypothesis Tester
recipes.description: Multi-branch EVALUATE with variable confidence threshold; evidence schema via TEXT return
args: hypothesis=Remote work increases software developer productivity

recipes.name: Parallel Code Review
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL 3 reviewer sub-WORKFLOWs (style, security, tests) + merge_reviews synthesis

recipes.name: Multi-Pass Code Review
recipes.description: read_file + severity-gated EVALUATE verdict; CALL read_file returns '' on missing file

recipes.name: Safe Generation
recipes.description: EVALUATE = exact string + EXCEPTION + RETRY WITH temperature LIMIT — hallucination guard
args: question=What are the main causes of the 2008 financial crisis?

recipes.name: Multi-Model Pipeline
recipes.description: Research → Analyze → Write with per-step USING MODEL; quality loop refines draft until score > 0.7
args: topic=the impact of large language models on software development

recipes.name: Headline News Aggregator
recipes.description: Generate headlines → expand → EVALUATE > 0.75 coverage → refine gaps → format

recipes.name: Memory-Augmented Chat
recipes.description: Extract facts → merge profile → reply; EVALUATE = 'no_new_facts'; trim_turns stdlib; stateless caller-managed
args: user_input=My name is Alice and I am a data scientist at a fintech startup

recipes.name: Credit Risk Assessment
recipes.description: EVALUATE < 600 / >= 750 int fast path; iif+contains stdlib replaces Python extraction tool
args: borrower_info=Annual income $85,000, credit score 720, existing debt $15,000, requesting $50,000 loan

recipes.name: Vision to Action
recipes.description: classify once + contains() decision tree — scene label routes to security/delivery/general action
args: image_description=A person in dark clothing approaches the back door of the building after hours

recipes.name: A/B Test
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL 2 variants + iif(to_int(@score_a) > to_int(@score_b)) winner selection

recipes.name: Structured Extraction
recipes.description: GENERATE JSON → validate → WHILE retry with enrichment; EVALUATE = 'valid' exits loop
args: raw_text=John Smith, 45, works as a senior software engineer at TechCorp in San Francisco. He joined in 2019 and earns $180,000 annually.

recipes.name: Plan and Execute
recipes.description: line_count(@plan) for step count; WHILE + split_part step extraction; EVALUATE = '' to skip empties
args: goal=Build a simple REST API with user authentication in Python

recipes.name: Text Analytics Pipeline
recipes.description: Four-way CALL PARALLEL (sentiment, entities, themes, summary); json_set accumulates structured report
args: text=The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points, citing persistent inflation and a strong labor market. Tech stocks dropped 2%.

recipes.name: Adversarial Refinement
recipes.description: Generator vs critic with WHILE AND compound condition; score-gated termination; argument hardens under attack
args: claim=Switching to a 4-day work week increases productivity

recipes.name: Adaptive Failover
recipes.description: Primary model → stdlib quality gate (word_count + contains) → transparent fallback to stronger model
args: query=Explain quantum entanglement for a technical audience

recipes.name: Prompt Self-Tuning
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL variant generation + A/B test on failing case + nested EVALUATE winner selection
args: failed_case=The document describes a novel quantum error-correction scheme.

recipes.name: Product Description Refiner
recipes.description: Draft → critique → rewrite → score with WHILE AND compound; early exit when critic is satisfied
args: product_info=Wireless noise-cancelling headphones, 40h battery, USB-C, foldable, touch controls

recipes.name: Tree of Thought
recipes.description: CALL PARALLEL 3 explore_path procedures (different models + reasoning lenses); score + select + refine; EVALUATE = 'sound' verify
args: problem=Design a sustainable urban transport system for a city of 2 million people.

recipes.name: Regulatory News Audit
recipes.description: WHILE line_count+split_part iteration; LLM JSON audit per item; json_get risk routing; EVALUATE = 'high' alert escalation

recipes.name: Socratic Tutor
recipes.description: Persona function injected into GENERATE args; 3-turn simulated dialogue; EVALUATE > understanding score routes consolidation vs hint
args: topic=How does recursion work in programming?

recipes.name: Autonomous Code Pipeline
recipes.description: Spec gate → gen → review → improve → test (WHILE AND loop) → document → optional closure check; 8 PROCEDURE sub-steps
args: spec=Write a binary search function that works on a sorted integer array and returns the index or -1 if not found.

recipes.name: Ollama Proxy
recipes.description: Minimal PROMPT workflow — pipe any prompt through any adapter/model; SELECT system role + user message; pure passthrough
args: prompt=Explain quantum computing in one sentence

recipes.name: RAG Query
recipes.description: Retrieval-augmented generation: SELECT context from external documents + GENERATE answer; PROMPT workflow with grounded knowledge
args: question=What is the main topic of the indexed documents?

recipes.name: Map-Reduce Summarizer
recipes.description: line_count + WHILE + split_part chunks document; GENERATE per-chunk summaries (map); GENERATE combined final (reduce); quality-score gate

recipes.name: Few-Shot Prompting
recipes.description: Gold-standard examples embedded in SELECT context; PROMPT workflow guides output format and style via in-context learning; no fine-tuning
args: text=The quarterly results exceeded all analyst forecasts by a significant margin

recipes.name: Parallel Code Review v2
recipes.description: IMPORT-based modular design: 3 sub-workflow files loaded at runtime; CALL PARALLEL style + security + test-gen run concurrently; merged report
args:
code=def divide(a, b):
    return a / b

recipes.name: Parallel News Digest
recipes.description: Sub-WORKFLOW per topic run concurrently; synthesise into morning briefing; IMPORT pattern

recipes.name: Geometry QA
recipes.description: Two-mode: answer_on_demand.spl (Q&A over concept graph) + build_concept_book.spl (concept-book generation); DODA pattern

recipes.name: Image Caption
recipes.description: Vision-model GENERATE: describe image from file path or URL; multimodal INPUT; PROMPT with structured question and log output
args: question=What is in this image? Describe it in detail.

recipes.name: Audio Summary
recipes.description: Speech-model GENERATE: transcribe and summarise an audio clip; multimodal INPUT; outputs transcript + summary

recipes.name: Video Summary
recipes.description: Video-understanding GENERATE: analyse clip and produce text summary, transcript, or key-moment list; multimodal INPUT

recipes.name: Text to Image
recipes.description: Image generation: text prompt → DALL-E 3 (cloud) or local Stable Diffusion; GENERATE IMAGE OUTPUT; saves result to file
args: prompt=A serene mountain lake at sunrise, photorealistic

recipes.name: Text to Speech
recipes.description: Speech synthesis: text → natural-sounding audio file; GENERATE AUDIO OUTPUT; configurable voice and speed
args: text=Hello, this is a text-to-speech demonstration.

recipes.name: Text to Video
recipes.description: Video generation: text prompt → short video clip via Google Veo 2 or similar; GENERATE VIDEO OUTPUT
args: prompt=A timelapse of a flower blooming in a sunny garden

recipes.name: Image Restyle
recipes.description: Vision → generation pipeline: describe image with vision model then generate restyled version; IMAGE INPUT → IMAGE OUTPUT
args: style=oil painting in the style of Van Gogh

recipes.name: Voice Dialogue
recipes.description: Full audio-in / audio-out pipeline: AUDIO INPUT → speech-to-text → LLM response → text-to-speech → AUDIO OUTPUT; end-to-end voice agent

recipes.name: Model Showdown
recipes.description: Same prompt to two Ollama models concurrently via CALL PARALLEL + PROCEDURE; compare responses side-by-side with LLM judge
args: prompt=What is the meaning of life?

recipes.name: Bedrock Quickstart
recipes.description: Fan out same prompt to three model families concurrently via CALL PARALLEL; compare with LLM judge; USING MODEL per PROCEDURE
args: prompt=Explain the CAP theorem in two sentences.

recipes.name: Vertex AI Quickstart
recipes.description: Fan out same prompt to Gemini Pro/Flash/Lite tiers concurrently via CALL PARALLEL; tier-comparison evaluation with cost recommendation
args: prompt=Explain the CAP theorem in two sentences.

recipes.name: Azure OpenAI Quickstart
recipes.description: Fan out same prompt to three Azure OpenAI deployments concurrently via CALL PARALLEL; compare GPT tiers for quality and cost-effectiveness
args: prompt=Explain the CAP theorem in two sentences.

recipes.name: ReAct Agent
recipes.description: PROCEDURE wraps GENERATE for population search; calc_growth_rate Python tool replaced with GENERATE compute_growth_rate

recipes.name: Guardrails Pipeline
recipes.description: 4-gate safety: contains() keyword pre-screen → LLM classify → GENERATE detect/redact PII → GENERATE validate output

recipes.name: Customer Support Triage
recipes.description: Classify → urgency score → EVALUATE > 8 escalation vs draft → quality check → revise; EVALUATE replaces SELECT CASE tone routing
args: ticket=I was charged twice for the same order. Please refund the duplicate charge.

recipes.name: Meeting Notes to Actions
recipes.description: CALL read_file + GENERATE replace Python tools; extract speakers, normalize dates, validate ownership; output as JSON/markdown/email
args: transcript=Alice: fix the login bug by Friday. Bob: I will handle it by end of week.

recipes.name: Sentiment Pipeline
recipes.description: Batch GENERATE sentiment on item list; GENERATE compute_stats and find_extremes replace Python tools; trend narrative + report

recipes.name: Interview Simulator
recipes.description: Interviewer+candidate personas; GENERATE questions; split_part extracts Q1-3; GENERATE score/aggregate/compile transcript
